title: TogafValueStream
description: TOGAF-sourced representation archetype — an end-to-end representation of value delivery from trigger to stakeholder outcome, spanning multiple GSM Structures. A cross-structural representation of how value flows through organizational capabilities. Rootless, domain-scoped. TOGAF mapping: Value Stream (Business Architecture, Value Stream Mapping). Source framework: TOGAF (Business Architecture, Value Stream Mapping).

valueType.description: Value stream contribution type. REVENUE_GENERATING = directly produces revenue. COST_REDUCING = reduces operational costs. ENABLING = supports other value streams. TOGAF mapping: Value Stream value classification.

stageCount.description: Number of value-adding stages in the stream. TOGAF mapping: Value Stream stage count.
